title_en: Everything Announced at the Diablo 5 BlizzCon 2026 Panel
summary_en: BlizzCon 2026 came with a lot of surprises, but few were as big as the Diablo 5 reveal – and we're about to learn even more.
body_en:
BlizzCon 2026 came with a lot of surprises, but few were as big as the Diablo 5 reveal – and we're about to learn even more.
Yes, in case you missed it, Blizzard Entertainment is working on Diablo 5. The fifth entry in its massively popular dungeon-crawler video game series is set to bring players to a ruined Sanctuary in spring 2029, but the news doesn't stop there.
"The heroes are gone, Sanctuary has fallen, and Diablo has won," Blizzard's Joe Shely said today. "For the first time, you won't be fighting to stop Diablo from taking Sanctuary. You'll enter a world where he already has. There are no towns, no safe places waiting to protect you."
The Diablo team is ready to reveal even more about the next big installment in the franchise with its BlizzCon 2026 Forging the Next Era panel. All we know so far is that the team plans to take viewers "inside the fallen Sanctuary." That means updates on how it's "evolving the world, classes, and the story for Diablo's next era."
We're going to round up all of the highlights from the Diablo 5 panel for you right here, so be sure to refresh this page when it begins at 1:45 p.m. PT / 4:45 p.m. ET. You can also check out everything announced during the BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony right here .
